import csv
tsid='4067b4b7-8ab8-5191-9408-9caf2ace6a09'
vals=[]
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.DictReader(f)

        if row['timeseries_id']==tsid and row['timestamp'].startswith('2018-10-23'):
            t=row['timestamp'][11:13]
            if '08'<=t<='18':
                vals.append((row['timestamp'], float(row['value'])))

print(vals)
mean=sum(v for _,v in vals)/len(vals)
